news.author: MissConstrue@mefi.social
news.snippet: Planes in the US are theoretically starting to move, according to the # FAA . Much ink will be spilled dissecting the disaster, so I’m just gonna jump the line and throw out my theory early. The FAA activated # SMART at all 22 ARTCCs on Tuesday, Nov. 10 — after a 6 week pilot at Reagan National, Dulles, and BWI. SMART is the product of a brand new # AI startup (Air Space Intelligence) who is still in funding rounds, but I’ll bet some Trump folks have vig in the game for them to have an $875 million, 12-year no-bid contract. The AI system hadn’t been tested on copper telco. Nobody even thought about copper. These AI apps came online and tried to stuff gigabytes of data down the throats of a TDM modem line: the physical medium and the switching gear simply can't handle the throughput, and the whole path collapses. Hence the routers fell over. They # DDOS ’d themselves. That’s my call.
